content.scenario: A consumer rights organization in India wants to investigate a complaint about a company engaging in unfair trade practices. They approach the Central Authority to inquire into the matter and file a complaint before the National Commission.
content.outcome: The Central Authority may inquire or cause an inquiry or investigation to be made into the violations of consumer rights or unfair trade practices, either suo motu or on a complaint received or on the directions from the Central Government, and file complaints before the National Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: How can I file a complaint about unfair trade practices?
What is the role of the Central Authority in consumer protection?
How can I report a violation of consumer rights?
